audio_segments.transcript: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. We have our telephone appointment now. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a moment to settle in?

Hello, Rachel. I'm in my office, door closed already. My FIN is T three double nine two four three seven L. My date of birth is the eighteenth of August nineteen fifty-three. Glad we arranged a short call. These days, if an appointment runs on, the rest of my diary gets pushed back.
We can keep the discussion focused and leave room for any questions. You mentioned you were planning a quieter work schedule. Has that started to take shape?

Slowly lah. The family business still keeps me busy, but the team can handle the daily transport schedules without me watching everything. I'm trying not to fill every gap with another meeting. Otherwise, quieter schedule only on paper.
It sounds as though the change is mainly about protecting your time. For future appointments, would you prefer that we continue arranging them in advance rather than calling unexpectedly?
Yes, appointments better. Then I can put the papers out and give you my attention. If you catch me between staff coming in and out, very hard to have a proper conversation.

I will note that contact preference. Turning to today's discussion, Your objective is to build a diversified source of investment income over a longer investment horizon; that is the objective I am using for this discussion.
I've got my notes beside me. Keep the explanation straightforward, please; no need for a long presentation.

I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its income-oriented bond portfolio supports your income objective and spreads exposure across issuers. That portfolio approach also fits your longer investment horizon.
Hmm, let me look at my notes a moment. All right, I'm listening.

With Orion Global Income Fund, rising interest rates can reduce the market value of the bonds it holds, which can lower the fund's unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could lower the value of your investment in this fund?
Yes, I understand. Rates go up, the bonds can fall in value, so my fund units can be worth less.
You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?
Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses. The value can fluctuate; I can accept that.
The transaction charge is 1,500 renminbi. I will pause here so you have room to speak.

For this investment, I want Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy, ah. The investment itself, use Japanese yen. For settling the charge only, use Chinese yuan, not for the investment itself. The amount I want to invest is 50,000,000. The quantity I want is 1,000 units. For the order type, I was going to say— Wait, use a limit order, with a maximum price per unit of 50,000 Japanese yen.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund for 50,000,000 Japanese yen, using a limit order with a maximum price per unit of 50,000 Japanese yen. Is that your instruction, and do you authorise me to place it?
Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please place the order as you read it back.

Thank you. Any administrative follow-up can go through our usual secure channel. If you have a question when reviewing the correspondence, you can contact me there rather than trying to catch me between appointments.

That works for keeping in touch. I prefer having the correspondence together, not scattered across messages. And thanks for keeping this call focused; still got some breathing room before my staff come in.
You're welcome, Adrian. I will leave you to the rest of your day. Thank you for making time for the discussion.
Thanks, Rachel. Hopefully I can keep the diary looking like this more often. Speak another time. Bye.
